column1: # mapping_set_title: Semantic mappings of geographic-area types to Wikidata
# mapping_set_description: Manually curated mappings from Dutch geographic-area classes used in the RDF data to Wikidata entities used in proposed FHIR Location neighbourhood-type representations.

column19: Proposed neighbourhoodType extension to FHIR Location (CodeableConcept). Country-specific administrative areas used in the Netherlands; equivalent spatial units may be defined differently in other countries.
